title: THE CAPTION OVER THE BELT IS PROMPT SIZE
why: The critic on the raid hud (screen 36): the line over the belt, the item name with fire and use, is 12 px type and cannot be read from a couch. It now takes the label size the world prompts use. The emote strip and wind-up bars above it already take their height from the same function, so they move up with it.
now: The line over the weapon belt is bigger and easier to read.
